::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
A second, distinct Linde facility from the Dholera ASU — an 8-acre high-purity chip-packaging gas plant specifically sized for Sanand's OSAT cluster (Micron, CG Power, Kaynes), rather than a fab. Together with Dholera, Linde is building what the company calls a 'dense regional gas supply network' across Gujarat's two semiconductor hubs.
:::

## What does this facility supply?

High-purity specialty gases for chip packaging/assembly-and-test operations.
